warnings: revenue: 1 fiscal year(s) where the first-choice tag disagrees with the filed quarters (sum of four >5% apart, or a year below its own nine months) while another filed tag agrees — that tag is used (2014-12-31 SalesRevenueNet 5,489,000,000 → Revenues 7,403,000,000)

revenue basis: the filer's own total (Revenues / RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) is used for 1 period(s) (2015-12-31) where it exceeds the contract-revenue line by >5% — the contract line is a component there
capex: the filed caption changes (2019-12-31 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment → PaymentsForCapitalImprovements) — growth across a change is blank

debt_issued: 1 derived quarter(s) (2014-09-30) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

stock_issued: 1 derived quarter(s) (2010-12-31) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

other non-operating: NonoperatingIncomeExpense is the filer's whole non-operating section (interest included) for some periods; shown as that total + interest expense − interest income (plain arithmetic, reconciles to pretax income) for 1 period(s); blank for 3 period(s) (2015-03-31, 2016-03-31, 2016-06-30) where neither reading reconciles to pretax income

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): cost_of_revenue 2008-12-31, cost_of_revenue 2009-12-31, gross_profit 2008-12-31, gross_profit 2009-12-31, rnd 2008-12-31, rnd 2009-12-31, sga 2008-12-31, sga 2009-12-31, general_admin 2010-12-31, general_admin 2011-12-31, other_opex 2008-12-31, other_opex 2009-12-31...

catch-all cash-flow quarters blanked (the two legs' filings present the section differently, so their difference is no filed figure; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_noncash 2023-12-31 (2,000,000 - 4,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds deferred_taxes); other_noncash 2025-09-30 (-3,000,000 - -4,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds deferred_taxes); other_investing 2013-09-30 (-5,000,000 - 4,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds acquisitions); other_financing 2015-12-31 (-9,000,000 - 22,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds stock_issued); other_financing 2017-09-30 (-2,000,000 - -8,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds debt_issued, debt_repaid); other_financing 2018-12-31 (-7,000,000 - -8,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds debt_issued)

free cash flow: 8 period(s) (2014-12-31..2016-12-31) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 26 period(s) with discontinued operations (2007-12-30..2016-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there

same filing: 5 fiscal-year cell(s) of a derived figure are blank because its inputs' values come from different filing generations (one restated by a later filing, the other as originally filed) although one filing reports them all: gross_margin 2014-12-31, gross_margin 2015-12-31, operating_margin 2014-12-31, operating_margin 2015-12-31, net_margin 2014-12-31

growth across filing generations: 88 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): accounts_payable (2013-12-31, 2015-12-31); accrued (2013-12-31, 2015-12-31); capex (2019-12-31); cash (2013-12-31); change_inventory (2008-12-31); cost_of_revenue (2009-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31); da (2010-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31); debt_repaid (2009-12-31); deferred_revenue_current (2013-12-31, 2015-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31); deferred_tax_liab (2014-12-31); discontinued_ops (2009-12-31, 2012-12-31); ...

filed zero against non-zero filings of the same period: 6 tag-period(s) where one filing tagged 0 while another filed a figure (a slip, not a restatement); the 0 is ignored: DeferredTaxLiabilitiesNoncurrent 2015-12-31: kept 8.6e+07, ignored 0 (10-K filed 2017-02-24); OtherNoncashIncomeExpense 2022-01-01..2022-12-31: kept 3e+07, ignored 0 (10-K filed 2025-02-14); OtherNoncashIncomeExpense 2022-12-31: kept 3e+07, ignored 0 (10-K filed 2025-02-14); OtherNoncashIncomeExpense 2025-01-01..2025-06-30: kept -4e+06, ignored 0 (10-Q filed 2026-07-31); ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised 2010-01-01..2010-06-30: kept 3e+06, ignored 0 (10-Q filed 2011-08-05); ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised 2010-01-01..2010-09-30: kept 3e+06, ignored 0 (10-Q filed 2011-11-04)

shifted column: 1 tag-period(s) where only the newest filing(s) carry the adjacent period's exact value (a mis-dated context, not a restatement); the earlier filings' value is kept: InterestExpense 2015-01-01..2015-09-30: kept 2.59e+08, ignored 2.54e+08 = the 2014-09-30 value (10-Q filed 2016-10-28)

sign: a payment the cash-flow statement shows as an outflow was filed NEGATIVE (the filer's sign slip); read as the absolute amount paid: RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit for 1 period(s) (2017-01-01..2017-09-30) in 10-Q filed 2017-10-27
